warnings: This set prints grid bubbles 1-11 (x) and A-F (y) on the structural plans S-01..S-03. Origin = A1 (A is the topmost named row).

Rows A/B and E/F are printed as two bubbles only 0.125 m apart: the outer chain prints A-C 3.625 and D-F 2.525, the inner chain B-C 3.50 and D-E 2.40, on every structural plan (S-01 twice, S-02 twice, S-03) — five drawings agree, so A = B - 0.125 and F = E + 0.125. Columns/footings sit on B, C, D, E (the inner chain); A and F are the outer edge lines.

Before-origin dummies hang off row B (the inner chain they are printed on): A' -3.875 (4.00 on the F1 beam plan; by scale this tick measures ~3.75 m, printed value taken), A'' -1.925 (roof plan 2.05), A''' -1.375 (F1 beam plan 1.50 overhang), A'''' -0.875 (F2/F3 plans 1.00). After F, dummies hang off row E: F' 10.525 (1.00, F2/F3), F'' 11.025 (1.50, F1 plan and รูปตัด ข), F''' 11.575 (2.05 roof), F'''' 11.795 (2.27, F2 plan), F''''' 12.025 (2.50, รูปตัด ก).

The building sections (รูปตัด ก/ข, p10) label the two column lines 7.00 apart as A and D (section ก prints bubbles A, B, D, E) — the plans call the same lines B and D (B-D = 3.50 + 3.50). Plans win (op01 precedence 1); the section chains are recorded against the plan names.

z: รูปตัด ก closes (0.85 + 3.50 + 3.50 + 3.00 = +10.85). รูปตัด ข prints classroom floors +4.45 / +7.95 and ระดับท้องคาน +10.85 but its top segment is printed 3.00 although +7.95 to +10.85 is 2.90 — it matches the corridor level +7.85 instead. Recorded as printed. Ground-floor corridor: +0.85 (section ก) vs +0.80 (section ข) — both recorded.

Swept: structural plans S-01..S-03 (p19-p21), building sections p10, floor plans p06 (แปลนพื้นชั้น 1 / ชั้นที่ 2). Its 3.50 | 1.00 | 2.00 entrance chain confirms 3' 9.50 / 4' 13.00 / 4'' 14.00 from a second sheet. NOT swept (computer scheduled shutdown 23:43 — op04 subagent clock): p07 (floor 3 + roof plan), p08-p09 (elevations), p11-p16 (stair/detail/door/wall sheets) and the stair-sheet dimensions on S-09 — their chains are not in this master yet.

Core/stair-bay lines (printed with leading dashes, read as tick marks): the S-02 stair chains '-1.90 | 2.25' (F3) and '-2.65 | 1.50' (F2) both total 4.15 and only meet the B4 stair beam when measured from row A (the outer line), so they are taken from A: B' 1.90, B'''' 2.65, C'' 4.15. The '-0.52' printed below row C on both floors gives C + 0.52 = 4.145 — 5 mm from C'' and the same B4 edge printed twice; both kept as lines (C' 4.145, C'' 4.15) per section 4 rule 4, B4 recorded on C''. S-01 '-2.00' (G2) taken from A as well = B'' 2.00; '-2.15' from C = C'''' 5.775 (B4A).

Classroom joists (B1, bays 2-3 to 9-10, all three floors) sit at two unprinted positions between B and D: by scale they divide the 7.00 B-D bay into thirds (measured B+2.41 / B+4.73 / B+7.03 on S-01, the third on row D). B''' 2.458 and C''' 4.792 = B + 7.00/3 and B + 2 x 7.00/3, position scaled from the grid (section 4 span amendment); each line carries its own 0.6 score.
